title: the title as written, or null
kind: one of the kinds listed in the task
summary: two to five sentences in English saying what the document is and what it says
components: a module, service, package, folder or product named in the text
people: a person or role as written

references.kind: id | path | anchor | version | url | mention

decisions.quote: a short quote from the text shown

status: current | draft | accepted | superseded | deprecated | snapshot | unstated
status_as_written: the words that say so, or null
superseded_by: what replaces it, as written, or null
self_rating: how the text rates its own reliability or currency, as written, or null

evidence.quote: a short quote from the text shown

reasoning: one to three sentences naming what you saw
